ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface, with approximately 15% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels localized to scarring, reflections, and calcified attachments.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black mass occupying 85% of surface area; high-contrast white pixel clusters (geometric blobs) concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes and linear white pixel strings scattered across the medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 1/4 of the vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge boundary with high-frequency serrations; significant pixel-depth variations (notches) present on both lobes, particularly near the outer margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature following a parabolic path from the median notch vertex toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (5-20 pixels in diameter) localized heavily on the right distal tip and sparsely on the left distal tip and interior surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scars/rake marks) of varying lengths (10-60 pixels) across the central and lower-medial areas of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring and barnacle colonization marks on both distal tips; significant linear rake marks across the mid-sections of both lobes, possibly representing interaction-based trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, high-density cluster of calcified protrusions (barnacles) on the extreme superior edge of the right lobe tip.
